mintAuthority.summary: Mint Authority covers only canonical Ethereum sUSN issuance and its inherited USN collateral dependency. Shares mint against deposited USN; the reviewed MinterHandlerV2 and 3-of-6 Noon admin Safe bound the inherited collateral path, while the Ethereum wrapper is a transparent proxy whose ProxyAdmin is governed by a 48-hour timelock owned by that Safe. The armed, expiry-free upgrade operation scheduled 2026-06-10 was cancelled on 2026-10-12, after a separately scheduled upgrade to implementation 0xef2ea425 executed on 2026-10-01, so no upgrade operation is pending and the 48-hour delay now binds wrapper logic changes; the same Safe separately holds instant no-timelock vault powers (pause, withdrawal-handler replacement, whitelist grants, token rescue, blacklist-role self-grant). Cross-chain lock/unlock, Hyperlane messaging, destination representations, and bridge administration are scored only under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: Noon sUSN transparent proxy
controls.capDescription: Transparent proxy; upgrade path: ProxyAdmin (0x1908284b) → owner 0xe5e412c → owner Safe 0x1ea169. Wrapper owner() also returns the same 3/6 Safe. The dormant upgrade to implementation 0xb9E5B8d826939580db142faBA61FcdEA9AAca6E7 (scheduled 2026-06-10) was cancelled on 2026-10-12 and no other operation is pending, so a wrapper logic change now requires a fresh schedule and the full 48-hour delay.

sources.label: Timelock cancellation of the dormant 2026-06-10 upgrade operation (2026-10-12)

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771191, the wrapper implementation slot returned 0xebbcbc6672683e1956125e7c5e89e14ceac8cd3d and the admin slot returned ProxyAdmin 0x190828...bd81; both reads were unchanged at block 26036288 on 2026-09-22. The current verified implementation adds PausableUpgradeable and a 48-hour stuck-message correction flow; those cross-chain transfer-rail surfaces are separately scored under bridgeRouteRisk. The wrapper itself has no separate privileged base-USN mint path; its native supply is issued through the staking deposit flow. The upgrade timelock still reports the operation scheduled 2026-06-10T17:24:59Z for implementation 0xb9E5B8d826939580db142faBA61FcdEA9AAca6E7 as armed (executable since 2026-06-12T17:24:59Z) with no expiry in the verified Timelock source, so the owning Safe can install it at any moment with zero further notice. Re-read 2026-10-19 at block 26227599: the implementation slot now returns 0xef2ea4250b7ce4d0aa9ca70607ecef278c6eab15 (Sourcify exact match, StakingVaultOFTUpgradeableHyperlane), installed by a timelock operation scheduled 2026-09-28 (block 26077061) and executed 2026-10-01 (block 26099062); the admin slot still returns ProxyAdmin 0x1908284b, whose owner() is the timelock. The 2026-06-10 operation for 0xb9E5B8... was cancelled by UpgradeCancelled at block 26175136 (2026-10-12), superseding the zero-notice finding above.

controls.label: Inherited USN MinterHandlerV2
controls.capDescription: Inherited USN MinterHandlerV2 minting is bounded by the parent USN handler's per-block/per-day and whitelist controls, which Noon admin controls can update.
controls.evidence: Inherited from the reviewed usn-noon mintAuthority. Verified MinterHandlerV2 source enforces per-block, per-day, whitelisted-user, and collateral checks; the handler itself does not hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: Inherited Noon admin Safe
controls.capDescription: Inherited MinterHandlerV2 limits: at Ethereum block 26095806, mintLimitPerBlock() and directMintLimitPerDay() each returned 10000000000000000000000000 USN base units (18 decimals). These are mutable transaction/window limits, not a hard economic supply cap; this Safe retains DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can raise them.
bypassSurfaces: Vault pause(), setWithdrawalHandler, whitelistAccount grants, rescueToken, and a self-granted BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE followed by blacklistAccount all execute instantly with no timelock; pausing the vault blocks new unstake requests, and neither pause nor blacklist has ever been used to date.

The WithdrawalHandler's setWithdrawPeriod enforces no minimum or maximum and the claim check reads the live value, so a change applies retroactively to withdrawal requests already in flight; the parameter is bounded only by the 48-hour GenericTimelock that has held the handler admin role since 2026-07-28, and that timelock's own ownership transfer is not timelocked. 7 of the 8 historical changes, including three 0-second windows, were direct calls that bypassed the timelock, the last one 46 minutes before the Safe renounced the handler admin role.

Three of this Safe's six owner keys (0xe45Bb0D3cC77702E1310BB621c59c778304A42D0, 0x09CE2d1C37772F7fF666B6447a66a5EBd2833799, 0x8B3641db7737fFab752718fcc772161eC09FaD01) are also owners of the 4-of-5 Noon collateral Safe; that overlap equals this Safe's threshold, so those three keys alone form a valid admin quorum for every power above.
controls.evidence: The parent USN review confirms this 3-of-6 Safe holds MinterHandlerV2 MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so it can execute bounded mints and change the handler's limits. Current Safe reads show six owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and a zero guard. Re-derived 2026-09-22 at block 26036288: on-chain getThreshold()/getOwners() still return 3-of-6, and the Safe remains the vault's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and owner() while no account holds the vault's BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE, so the Safe must self-grant that role before blacklisting, an instant untimelocked step. The Safe also owns the USN token directly, whose owner-only pause() and blacklistAccount(address) carry no timelock and can freeze the USN claim leg of an sUSN withdrawal after its 7-day wait.

controls.label: sUSN Ethereum upgrade timelock
bypassSurfaces: The verified Timelock source defines no expiry or grace period for scheduled operations, so any future upgrade, once its 172800-second delay has elapsed, stays executable by the owner Safe until it is executed or cancelled; no operation is pending as of block 26227599 (2026-10-19).

capSemanticsReview.rationale: D14 review of Sourcify-verified StakingVaultOFTUpgradeableHyperlane implementation 0xebbcbc6672683e1956125e7c5e89e14ceac8cd3d: native deposit/mint uses inherited ERC4626Upgradeable._deposit, transferring USN before _mint(receiver,shares). rebase transfers underlying without creating shares. Both _credit and Hyperlane handle unlock existing vault-held shares via _update(address(this),recipient,amount); the administrative stuck-message repair likewise requires sufficient locked balance and transfers rather than mints. No wrapper-local privileged share mint or new share-minter grant exists. Inherited MinterHandlerV2 and Safe limit powers issue parent USN and travel through the serial-claim dependency edge, not a second sUSN charge. The armed proxy upgrade is retained as upgrade risk, not a D14 trigger.

review.evidence: The sUSN wrapper mints only against deposited USN and inherits the parent MinterHandlerV2 plus Noon 3-of-6 admin Safe. At Ethereum block 25771191, its transparent proxy resolved to current implementation 0xebbcbc6672683e1956125e7c5e89e14ceac8cd3d and ProxyAdmin 0x190828...bd81; the ProxyAdmin owner was a verified 172800-second timelock owned by the same Safe. The current implementation adds PausableUpgradeable and a 48-hour stuck-message correction flow; these cross-chain transfer-rail capabilities are reviewed under bridgeRouteRisk and are not independent issuer mint paths. Non-Ethereum contracts are reviewed as third-party bridge representations, not independent issuer mint paths. Local sUSN supply is deposit-gated, and live ERC-4626 accounting covers all wrapper shares through Accountable without a named prudential supervisor. Adverse re-review on 2026-09-22 at block 26036288 corrects the earlier unqualified 48-hour-upgrade claim: the upgrade timelock still holds the armed, expiry-free operation scheduled 2026-06-10 that would install vault implementation 0xb9E5B8...a6e7, so replacing wrapper mint logic currently requires no notice at all until that operation is executed or cancelled. The admin Safe separately holds instant, no-timelock powers over the vault (pause, which blocks new unstake requests; setWithdrawalHandler; whitelist grants; rescueToken; self-grant of BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE followed by blacklistAccount) and over USN, whose owner-only pause and blacklistAccount can freeze the USN claim leg of a withdrawal after its 7-day wait. The WithdrawalHandler's withdrawPeriod is unbounded in both directions: setWithdrawPeriod enforces no minimum or maximum, the claim check reads the live value so a change applies retroactively to requests already in flight, and the only bound is the 48-hour GenericTimelock that became handler admin on 2026-07-28. 7 of the 8 historical changes, including three 0-second windows, were direct calls that bypassed the timelock, and that timelock's own ownership transfer is not timelocked. Three of the admin Safe's six owner keys are shared with the 4-of-5 collateral Safe, matching the admin threshold, so those keys alone form a valid admin quorum. D14 review of Sourcify-verified StakingVaultOFTUpgradeableHyperlane implementation 0xebbcbc6672683e1956125e7c5e89e14ceac8cd3d: native deposit/mint uses inherited ERC4626Upgradeable._deposit, transferring USN before _mint(receiver,shares). rebase transfers underlying without creating shares. Both _credit and Hyperlane handle unlock existing vault-held shares via _update(address(this),recipient,amount); the administrative stuck-message repair likewise requires sufficient locked balance and transfers rather than mints. No wrapper-local privileged share mint or new share-minter grant exists. Inherited MinterHandlerV2 and Safe limit powers issue parent USN and travel through the serial-claim dependency edge, not a second sUSN charge. The armed proxy upgrade is retained as upgrade risk, not a D14 trigger. Re-read 2026-10-19 at Ethereum block 26227599: the vault proxy now resolves to implementation 0xef2ea4250b7ce4d0aa9ca70607ecef278c6eab15 via a timelocked upgrade scheduled 2026-09-28 and executed 2026-10-01, and the armed 2026-06-10 operation was cancelled on 2026-10-12, so no upgrade is pending and the 48-hour delay binds wrapper logic changes; the D14 cap-semantics review above was performed on the prior implementation 0xebbcbc66. Source-scope correction reviewed 2026-10-22: Withdraw continuous reconciliation and attestation-only supervision from this sUSN authority review. The earlier assertion that Accountable covers all wrapper shares is not established by a cited sUSN-specific whole-liability reconciliation or examiner report; parent USN reserve/supply assurance does not establish the sUSN share and withdrawal-liability perimeter or its independent admin authority. The cited implementation and deposit gating establish local issuance mechanics, not the claimed independent assurance. The original review start, authority and implementation observations, and all evidence clocks are unchanged.
